senses.sense_definition: An illusion, delusion, or fabrication of the mind; an impossible or foolish idea.

examples.text: His plan to build a kingdom in the jungle turned out to be an idle <w>chimera</w>.
World peace seemed like a distant <w>chimera</w> during the height of the border conflict.

senses.sense_definition: Any mythical or imaginary creature composed of parts from different animals.

examples.text: Ancient myths often feature a <w>chimera</w> combining the body of a goat with a serpent tail.
The artist sculpted a terrifying <w>chimera</w> that guarded the fantasy castle entrance.

senses.sense_definition: Anything composed of very disparate or incongruous parts.

examples.text: The custom automobile was an odd <w>chimera</w> of vintage parts and modern racing tech.
The novel represents a stylistic <w>chimera</w>, blending science fiction with historical romance.

senses.sense_definition: An organism composed of genetically distinct cells originating from two or more zygotes.

examples.text: The forensic investigator realized the patient was a genetic <w>chimera</w> after matching blood samples.
A natural <w>chimera</w> can occur when two fraternal twin embryos fuse early in development.

senses.sense_definition: Alternative letter-case form of <w>Chimera</w>, the fire-breathing monster from Greek mythology.

examples.text: The ancient hero Bellerophon flew upon Pegasus to slay the terrifying <w>chimera</w>.
Depictions of the legendary <w>chimera</w> appear on numerous painted Greek vases.

senses.sense_definition: A grotesque carved figure resembling a gargoyle, but not serving as a waterspout.

examples.text: Perched along the high cathedral parapet, a brooding stone <w>chimera</w> looked over Paris.
Unlike true gargoyles, each decorative <w>chimera</w> on the church roof served no plumbing purpose.

senses.sense_definition: A cartilaginous marine fish of the subclass Holocephali with a blunt snout and long tapering tail.

examples.text: The deep-sea research submarine filmed a strange <w>chimera</w> gliding slowly over the ocean floor.
A deep-dwelling <w>chimera</w> uses broad pectoral fins to maneuver through pitch-black waters.

senses.sense_definition: A terrifying thing, especially an unreal or imagined threat.

examples.text: Nightly terrors filled his youthful imagination with fearful shapes and an unknown <w>chimera</w>.
She learned to ignore every manufactured <w>chimera</w> that once kept her anxious in the dark.

senses.sense_definition: A fire-breathing monster in Greek mythology with a lion's head, goat's body, and serpent's tail, slain by Bellerophon.

examples.text: In Greek legend, Bellerophon mounted the winged horse Pegasus to defeat the dreaded <w>Chimera</w>.
The <w>Chimera</w> ravaged the countryside of Lycia until it was finally vanquished.

senses.sense_definition: An ancient burning mountain in Lycia, presumed to correspond to the Yanartaş area of modern Turkey.

examples.text: Ancient travelers wrote of Mount <w>Chimera</w>, where natural vents of burning gas lit up the night.
The eternal flames on the slopes of <w>Chimera</w> inspired numerous mythological tales in antiquity.

senses.sense_definition: Former name of Himara, a coastal town in southern Albania.

examples.text: Historical marine charts documented the port of <w>Chimera</w> along the rugged Ionian coast.
Merchants sailing north toward Venice frequently made brief stops at <w>Chimera</w> for shelter.

senses.sense_definition: Former name of the Ceraunian Mountains, a coastal range in southern Albania.

examples.text: Sailors were often wary of the sheer cliffs of Mount <w>Chimera</w> rising abruptly from the water.
The high peaks of <w>Chimera</w> effectively separated ancient coastal settlements from inland tribes.
